name: weird-absurdist
_comment: ARM G — 'The Absurdist'. Parser and executor torture: contradictions, negations, self-attacks, orders to enemy marshals, orders to marshals who do not exist, impossible geography, capital cessions, self-declarations of war, an attempted prompt injection, absurd quantities, empty input, and the printed-vs-key name forms the NPC-1 cluster was landed to fix. Every line here is something a real player might type in a moment of curiosity, boredom or malice. What matters is not that the game obeys — it is that the game REFUSES HONESTLY, in character, and never silently does a different thing than the words say.
